lead: A new playbook bullet whose lead-in starts with the same words as an existing one can break every goal record at once.
body: A `[context] playbook` selector such as `Tooling > a commit` matches lead-ins by prefix, so adding "A commit that …" beside "A commit message …" made it open two, and `bun nv chain --check` (in `tools/nv/cmd/orient.ts`) failed for every goal naming it. Before adding a bullet, grep `data/goals/` for a selector its first words would extend, and lengthen that selector in the same commit (`bun nv splice --patch` does all the records in one call).
